listed_quote.quote: today announced a definitive agreement to merge four non-traded business development companies (BDCs) under its advisement

announcement.quote: FS/KKR Advisor, LLC (FS/KKR), a partnership between FS Investments and KKR Credit Advisors (US) LLC, today announced a definitive agreement to merge four non-traded business development companies (BDCs) under its advisement

outcome_evidence.quote: today announced a definitive agreement to merge four non-traded business development companies (BDCs) under its advisement

deals.notes: Funds are non-traded BDCs; listing on the NYSE was planned only for the combined entity after the mergers. The shareholder vote approved the mergers (8-K 0001193125-19-298805, 2019-11-22) and the closing of the mergers was announced in 8-K 0001193125-19-317712 filed 2019-12-18.
